rfam.comment: 2dG-I riboswitch is a Purine riboswitche, is involved in feedback control of deoxyguanosine biosynthesis and its structure has been reported in PDB 3SKI, 3SKZ, 3SLM, 3SLQ included in the alignment and PDB 3SKL, 3SKR, 3SKT, 3SKW not included here [2]
